activities.name: Walking in the western Highlands and Skye
activities.note: nothing closes; the midges are simply a fact of the western Highlands in summer, and worst in still air at dawn and dusk near standing water. Edinburgh and the east coast are largely spared

windows.reason: peak midge season — July is the worst month, and Glen Coe, Torridon and the Cuillin foothills on Skye are the worst places
long enough days for the hills, either side of the midges
